question: Where in India is the Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit situated?
solution:
The correct option is **Kerala. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of **India's leading institutes for Sanskrit instruction**, study, and invention is the** Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit (SSUS).** In 1993, the University was established in Kalady, Kerala.
 
• **Student percentage - **
 
 
• Over **90%** of the university's students and research scholars come from **economically and socially underprivileged **communities and families,
 
• More than** 70%** of the students are **female**.
 
 
 
• **Nine regional centres - **
 
 
• **Kalady, Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur, Panmana, Thuravoor, Ettumanoor, Tirur, Koyilandy, and Payyannur **are the principal campuses.
 
 
 
• **Location of the university - **
 
 
• In order to serve students from disadvantaged backgrounds, the bulk of these campuses are located in rural areas of the State.
